items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: that's when I met him and he opened the Le Ruban Bleu a few months afterwards and I went in there.

ctx.x: It was 4 East 56th Street. And I happened to have been downtown somewhere and Jacoby and Jimmy Daniels who had worked for him, happened to be at the same place at the same time. I know what, they were going to do a picture of a composit picture of what was going on in New York at the time for Esquire Magazine. And they had some girls there from Billy Roses cabaret and so Jacoby, Jimmy Daniels and I happened to be there at the same time so we were in the montage also.
